changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE qrtz_blob_triggers DROP CONSTRAINT qrtz_blob_triggers_sched_name_fkey;
ALTER TABLE qrtz_cron_triggers DROP CONSTRAINT qrtz_cron_triggers_sched_name_fkey;
ALTER TABLE qrtz_simple_triggers DROP CONSTRAINT qrtz_simple_triggers_sched_name_fkey;
ALTER TABLE qrtz_simprop_triggers DROP CONSTRAINT qrtz_simprop_triggers_sched_name_fkey;
ALTER TABLE qrtz_triggers DROP CONSTRAINT qrtz_triggers_sched_name_fkey;
UPDATE qrtz_job_details SET sched_name = 'ilm-scheduler', job_group = 'ilm', job_class_name = REPLACE(job_class_name, 'com.czertainly', 'com.otilm') WHERE sched_name = 'czertainly-scheduler';
UPDATE qrtz_triggers SET sched_name = 'ilm-scheduler', job_group = 'ilm', trigger_group = 'ilm' WHERE sched_name = 'czertainly-scheduler';
UPDATE qrtz_cron_triggers SET sched_name = 'ilm-scheduler', trigger_group = 'ilm' WHERE sched_name = 'czertainly-scheduler';
UPDATE qrtz_simple_triggers SET sched_name = 'ilm-scheduler', trigger_group = 'ilm' WHERE sched_name = 'czertainly-scheduler';
UPDATE qrtz_fired_triggers SET sched_name = 'ilm-scheduler', job_group = 'ilm', trigger_group = 'ilm' WHERE sched_name = 'czertainly-scheduler';
UPDATE qrtz_paused_trigger_grps SET sched_name = 'ilm-scheduler', trigger_group = 'ilm' WHERE sched_name = 'czertainly-scheduler';
UPDATE qrtz_simprop_triggers SET sched_name = 'ilm-scheduler', trigger_group = 'ilm' WHERE sched_name = 'czertainly-scheduler';

ALTER TABLE qrtz_cron_triggers ADD CONSTRAINT qrtz_cron_triggers_sched_name_fkey FOREIGN KEY (sched_name, trigger_name, trigger_group) REFERENCES qrtz_triggers (sched_name, trigger_name, trigger_group);

ALTER TABLE qrtz_simple_triggers ADD CONSTRAINT qrtz_simple_triggers_sched_name_fkey FOREIGN KEY (sched_name, trigger_name, trigger_group) REFERENCES qrtz_triggers (sched_name, trigger_name, trigger_group);

ALTER TABLE qrtz_simprop_triggers ADD CONSTRAINT qrtz_simprop_triggers_sched_name_fkey FOREIGN KEY (sched_name, trigger_name, trigger_group) REFERENCES qrtz_triggers (sched_name, trigger_name, trigger_group);

ALTER TABLE qrtz_blob_triggers ADD CONSTRAINT qrtz_blob_triggers_sched_name_fkey FOREIGN KEY (sched_name, trigger_name, trigger_group) REFERENCES qrtz_triggers (sched_name, trigger_name, trigger_group);
ALTER TABLE qrtz_triggers ADD CONSTRAINT qrtz_triggers_sched_name_fkey FOREIGN KEY (sched_name, job_name, job_group) REFERENCES qrtz_job_details (sched_name, job_name, job_group);
